name: plotarmordev/drama-tensorfold
title: Drama 3 NVFP4 prune keeps 5900 of 10240 experts: 18 GB on disk and under 17 GB of GPU memory
summary: A community TensorFold quant of Fish Audio's Drama 3 speech model drops about 2.4 GB by keeping 5900 of 10240 experts and storing them as NVFP4. The author reports 18 GB on disk, a peak under 17 GB of GPU memory, and no measured quality drop versus the prior unofficial quant, and published both the weights and the recipe.

appearances.summary: A Drama Tensorfold update serves Fish Audio Drama 3 on a DGX Spark and a Mac through the same OpenAI-style /v1/audio/speech endpoint. One command starts it on the Mac, and cloned voices made on the Spark work there too.

appearances.summary: Drama 3, a voice model that runs on your own computer, now shuts down its voice server when the tool that started it exits, freeing the RAM. It runs on DGX or Mac.

appearances.title: Drama 3 reads speaker tags for multi-voice scripts
appearances.summary: A Drama 3 recipe for DGX Spark and Mac now reads speaker tags, so one script can be voiced by several speakers. The 4-bit build finished every dialogue test; the full model can run long on short tagged lines.
